description: Implementation of MediaDrmMetrics class for tracking DRM metrics, including session management, timing, and serialization of metrics data.

classes.name: MediaDrmMetrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and serializing DRM metrics, including session timing, counters, and event statistics.

methods.name: MediaDrmMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing various counters and metrics.

methods.name: SetSessionStart
methods.description: Records the start time of a DRM session identified by sessionId.

methods.name: SetSessionEnd
methods.description: Records the end time of a DRM session identified by sessionId.

methods.name: GetSerializedMetrics
methods.description: Serializes collected metrics into a string for reporting.

methods.name: GetSessionLifespans
methods.description: Returns the map of session IDs to their start and end times.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current time in milliseconds.
